m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Look at this place, will you? To think, Catstantinople was once the capital of the Ancient Qhat Empire. In the end? Buried and forgotten.
All right, well, enough sightseeing. The entrance to the Snakish Passage should be right over there. That'll get us into the Prison.
Looks like this is the welcoming party... quiet bunch, eh? Look, Wizard, you're gonna have to take the lead here. Ghosts are not my thing.
What? No repentant apology? No throwaway sour grapes line? Just plain, dumb silence. I know they're ghosts, but I expected something. Let's go.
Oh, you gotta be kidding me! More of these quiet Qhats? It's a little unnerving. Yeah, I don't like this, not at all. Let's get it over with.
So... what do you do when you're not Wizarding? Actually, never mind. I hate small talk, but this silence is killing me. Let's just keep moving.
Finally, the Emperor himself... C'mon! Surely you've got something to say for yourself... some vague, empty threat? This is crazy!
Really? A haunted meow? Now I see why you guys keep quiet. The silence was better than that. Wizard, let's wipe the floor with this guy.
All right, I have to admit, those Ancient Qhats weren't nearly as tough as I expected. Guess that's why they got beat by Baboolon.
Anyhow, this should lead us straight into the heart of Tetrus Prison, and I believe that's where we'll find our girl.
We're in. You see? When Snake Plizkin strikes a deal, he delivers. Our girl's behind bars somewhere on this cell block.
Hey! Aren't you a little short for a Guard? And you with one eye? What are you guys, a comedy duo...? You're here to rescue me? Oh, that's funny.
As much as I enjoy sowing the seeds of chaos and disorder among the Serpentines, I must admit, I am more than ready to leave this hole.
Don't count your snake eggs before they hatch, Mongu. Looking at these Blueprints - we can't break in the way I broke out.
Only way we're getting in is through the Ruins of Catstantinople. I assume you know Istanboa was Catstantinople. Long time gone now, of course.
Don't ask me why it got the works. I just know there's a path in the Ruins, the Snakish Passage - and we can use that to get into Tetrus Prison.
Troubling. I heard those Ruins are haunted by the ghosts of the Ancient Qhats. But if you are sure this is the only way, then so be it.
Good luck down there. I would accompany you, but as you know, I have been formally uninvited, so I will await you here.
